name: Lion-Skull Klar
body:
Price 19,912 gp; Slot shield; CL 7th; Weight 6 lbs.; Aura moderate illusion

DESCRIPTION

This +2 klar is shaped from the skull of a lion.

The shape of the skull allows the wielder to properly hold and shoot a shortbow (though not a longbow) while still benefiting from the Lion-Skull klar’s shield bonus.

Up to three times per day as a free action, the wielder of a Lion-Skull klar can utter praise to the nature totem of the moon. The next arrow fired after the prayer trails a line of shimmering stars in its wake. If a creature is struck by this arrow, the stars orbit it for the next 8 rounds, negating any concealment for the target and causing it to emit light as if it were holding a sunrod.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 10,037 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells wandering star motes; Special creator must be proficient with a shortbow
